The second! We are on vacation now.

en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “My parents are in vacation now.” The right way is “My parents are on vacation now.” In Portuguese we say “estar de férias”, and many people translate it as “in vacation”, but in English it is “on vacation”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
